relationships.subject: des-Arg9-bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: The data also show that KCa channels are the final mediators of the hyperpolarizing responses to DBK and LPS.

relationships.subject: R715
relationships.evidence_quote: DBK and LPS responses were inhibited by the B1 receptor antagonist R715 and by iberiotoxin in both cases.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: we suggest an interaction between the B1R and TLR4, since the hyperpolarization induced by LPS could be abolished in the presence of R715

key_findings: Endothelial B1R overexpression allows aortic hyperpolarization to DBK, mediated by KCa channels.
LPS hyperpolarization blocked by R715 suggests B1R-TLR4 interaction.
